question: External cephalic version (ECV) is contraindicated in a woman with an uncomplicated frank breech presentation at 36 weeks gestation with no previous uterine scars.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: ECV is not contraindicated here — it is the recommended first-line intervention. The British and Indian guidelines recommend offering ECV from 36 weeks for uncomplicated breech presentations; contraindications include previous uterine scar, placenta praevia, ruptured membranes, fetal compromise, and multiple pregnancy.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. ECV is actually recommended from 36 weeks in uncomplicated frank breech presentations without contraindications. It achieves successful version in approximately 50–60% of cases and reduces the caesarean section rate.
